preflights.error: Error: Timed out: private Pulse server

limits: Virtual browser receivers on one Linux host, not physical phones or Wi-Fi.
Looped two-tone source and one-second RMS windows establish activity only.
Recovery includes polling and a complete monitor window; no source-to-output latency or skew measurement.
Full outage retains pause policy and fixed eight-second explicit Play.
Three trials per reconnect case are exploratory comparisons, not a statistical capacity or reliability qualification.
Post-churn soak uses the same browser processes after six reconnects, not a fresh-start soak.
No missing/concealed source durations, DAC timing, renderer underruns or independent clock claims.
